accountName.title: Account Name / Handle
accountName.caption: Set an account name for this account.

setting.caption: Update your (active) account name or pick/unpick an ADA Handle.

adaHandle.select: Pick which ADA Handle to show instead of your account name (uncheck to show the name instead):

error.empty: Your account name can't be empty.
error.duplicate: This wallet already has an account with that name.

acct_xvk.label: Account Pub Key
acct_xvk.caption:
This account's public key.

CIP-1852's extended account public key.

Importing a public key lets you see the account history in read-only mode, without being able to sign.

acct_shared_xvk.label: Wallet Multi-Sig Pub Key
acct_shared_xvk.caption:
The Multi-Sig key of your selected wallet, to share with the person who's creating a Multi-Sig wallet.

CIP-1854's extended account public key.

samMode.title: Single Address Mode (SAM)
samMode.caption: Only use one address for all your transactions.

setting.caption: When this is on, all your funds will usually be kept on the first receive address.

customAddress.title: Heads up!
customAddress.text: Setting a custom receive address will make all change outputs and receive addresses switch to this address, even if it's not yours. Please double-check that you've set the right address.

notification.wrongNetwork: This address is from a different network.
notification.notOwned: This address doesn't belong to this account and can't be used as your custom receive address.
notification.nonStaking: The funds at this receive address are staked with an external stake key. You won't control the rewards they earn.
notification.error: Failed to save custom receive address!

setting.caption: When this is on, Eternl will provide collateral for your account.
setting.info: Interacting with smart contracts might need collateral if a transaction fails. Eternl will handle this automatically if it finds a suitable UTxO.
setting.waiting: You've sent a collateral transaction. Please hang tight, it hasn't been confirmed yet.
setting.foundCollateral: You already have a collateral UTxO for this account. It'll be used when you interact with smart contracts.
setting.noCollateral: No collateral UTxO found. Please set one by tapping the button below.

setCollateral.label: Set Collateral
setCollateral.tooltip: Set a collateral UTxO for this account.

warning.headline: Collateral is a setting for each account.

info.text: $t(common:appName) can use any UTxO with no tokens and a value between ####minimumCollateral#### and ####maximumCollateral#### as collateral. When you turn this setting on, it'll look for a suitable UTxO. If none is available, a button will pop up to help you set one.

setting.caption: Manually sync your wallet. If this is on, you'll need to sync your wallet yourself by clicking the sync icon.

When you turn this on, your wallet will sync your account's full transaction history. Otherwise, it'll only sync the last 1000 transactions. Syncing happens in batches, so it might take a bit for accounts with lots of history.
setting.syncing: History sync is still running. Waiting to sync {{AMOUNT}} entries.

tokenFragmentation.title: Token Fragmentation (TF)
tokenFragmentation.caption: Reduce transaction fees by fragmenting your tokens.

fragment.label: Token Bundle Size
fragment.info:
This sets how many tokens each UTxO output should have. It's a balance between low transaction fees and how much of your funds are locked in your wallet.
Small bundle size -> lower fees, more Ada locked.
Large bundle size -> higher fees, less Ada locked.

setting.caption: Split tokens into bundles when sending if there are more tokens in change than the value you've set. Depending on your wallet's UTxO/Token distribution and what you're trying to achieve, you might need to tweak these values for the best result.

advancedUtxoManagement.title: Advanced UTxO Management
advancedUtxoManagement.caption: Use advanced UTxO management for your transactions.

setting.caption: When enabled, $t(common:appName) will use advanced UTxO management for your transactions.
setting.subCaption: It keeps 10 UTxOs handy for parallel transaction execution. It'll also try to keep a 5 {{currency}} collateral UTxO available for smart contract interactions.

setting.caption: When you turn this on, rewards will automatically be withdrawn as you create a transaction. If it's disabled, or if you want to manually withdraw, use the 'Claim' button on the Staking page.

disabled.title: Auto Withdrawal Disabled
disabled.actionCart: Action cart system activated in Eternl. This disables auto-withdrawal to allow for predictable intents. You can choose to add a withdrawal action manually.
disabled.cip149: You activated DRep compensation (CIP149) for this account. This disables auto-withdrawal to allow rewards to accumulate and your DRep getting paid. You can choose to withdraw your rewards manually any time.

unStake.title:
Unstake wallet
(De-register wallet)
unStake.caption: Undelegate your current account from any pool and create a de-registration transaction.

setting.caption: This creates an account de-registration transaction. Once it's done, your account will be undelegated from any pool, and the key deposit from when you first delegated it will be returned to you.
setting.subCaption: Please note: any pending rewards from pool delegation, catalyst rewards, etc. will be lost when your account is de-registered!
setting.acknowledged: I understand that any pending rewards will be lost.
setting.noUtxo: {{currency}} needed to pay the de-registration transaction fee.

deReg.label: De-register Account
deReg.tooltip: De-register your account from pool delegation.

deRegDRep.title: Deregister as DRep
deRegDRep.caption: This will create a DRep de-registration transaction. Any voting power delegated to that DRep will be lost.

setting.caption: This will create a DRep de-registration transaction. Any voting power delegated to that DRep will be lost.
setting.subCaption: To be able to withdraw your staking rewards again, you'll need to delegate your account to a different DRep.
setting.acknowledged: I understand that all delegated voting power will be lost.
setting.noUtxo: {{currency}} needed to pay the de-registration transaction fee.

deReg.label: De-register Account
deReg.tooltip: De-register your account from pool delegation.
